purpose: Foundation cohort for CPG-VAL-001 through CPG-VAL-007 (post-IAMAtlas-build era). Anchored at this path by the v2 Evidence Report. Per-cell-type A-score CSVs in this folder ARE the production outputs of the IAMAtlas-native pipeline run on the foundation cohort (Walther IAM Deconvolver + IAMAtlas REBUILD + iamatlas_a_scoring.py with 115-cell markers v0_2).
manifest_authored: 2026-06-02 (Walther, retroactive documentation per v3 inventory protocol)

cohort_source_paper.citation: Severi G et al. Epigenome-wide methylation in DNA from peripheral blood as a marker of risk for breast cancer. Carcinogenesis 2014;35(10):2349-2357

geo_accessions.raw_composition_note: 146 C50 breast cancer cases + 177 controls + 6 other (filtered out)
76 colorectal + 76 breast + 424 controls + others (filtered to breast >10yr pre-dx + controls only)

files_in_this_folder.schema: gsm, arm (case|hc), then 115 cell-type A-score columns
gsm, arm (case|hc), then 115 cell-type A-score columns

consumed_by.CPG-VAL-001: Per-cell-type A-score fan-out — direct input. Headline: Baso d=+1.577/+1.010, Plasma cells +1.264/+0.813, Microglia +1.304/+0.707, breast-epithelial (BE) +1.281/+0.614 tissue-of-origin, ...
consumed_by.CPG-VAL-002: Mahalanobis hyper-volume — 115-D feature vector built from these per-cell-type A-scores. Headline: d=+1.871/+2.088 case-vs-HC
consumed_by.CPG-VAL-003: Per-CpG residual map — uses Walther deconvolution fractions (separate β-level analysis), but this cohort. Headline: 1,392 concordant CpGs
consumed_by.CPG-VAL-005: PC2 T-cell suppression axis — PCA on 115-cell A-score covariance from these CSVs. Headline: d=-0.67/-0.58
consumed_by.CPG-VAL-007: Age-axis subtraction — re-projection of these A-scores after removing age component. Headline: Mahalanobis improved +0.255 on GSE51032 after age subtraction

reproducibility_note: An independent investigator with these two CSVs + the production runtime modules (walther_clinical_runtime/) can reproduce CPG-VAL-001/002/005/007's headline numbers from these inputs alone. CPG-VAL-003 and CPG-VAL-004 require the raw β matrix, not just the A-scores — those are reconstructible from the GEO IDATs via Walther IAM Deconvolver.
